purpose: Correct the read-only pc-prod runner diagnostic to the upstream GitHub Actions runner v2.336.0 persisted-settings schema and collect connectivity evidence even when runner identity metadata is absent or mismatched.
approvedBy: repository-owner direct continuation of Gekta SPEED #3896 and REG.RU release recovery on 2026-08-14
requiredBehavior: owner-only command is bound to issue 3365 and exact literal /tai diagnose-pc-prod-runner-v2 current-main
execute only from a GitHub-hosted runner through the existing protected REG.RU root SSH key and pinned host fingerprint
resolve exact current main before diagnostics
use upstream RunnerSettings names AgentName ServerUrl GitHubUrl ServerUrlV2, while accepting legacy lowercase aliases only as diagnostic compatibility
derive the expected runner name from the single existing pc-prod systemd service and report identity match/mismatch without aborting network evidence
allow network probes only to fixed GitHub hosts or hosts derived from runner settings that pass strict GitHub-owned hostname suffix allowlists
aggregate only allowlisted diagnostic categories from the latest Runner diagnostic and recent systemd journal; never publish raw diagnostic text
collect read-only service process filesystem and inode evidence
forbiddenCapabilities: systemctl start stop restart enable disable daemon-reload or service mutation
runner registration re-registration removal token consumption config.sh or svc.sh invocation
reading or publishing .credentials .credentials_rsaparams OAuth tokens registration tokens or raw runner settings
publishing raw journal or runner diagnostic log lines
probing arbitrary hosts paths ports URLs or user-controlled remote commands
Docker container image volume network build-cache registry or configuration mutation
application deployment rollback restart or configuration mutation
database model-host deal role money registration credential or customer-data mutation
new server paid API SaaS or recurring cost
